When fixing a bug, addressing tester or issue feedback, or about to claim a change is
"done" / "fixed" / "working": reproduce the reported symptom FIRST, then produce a RECEIPT -
a re-runnable acceptance test (or a `receipt-cmd:` probe) that is RED before the fix and
GREEN after, asserting the reporter's symptom on the surface they actually see. Assert the
exact expected value, never merely "not the old value". A fix is not done because you say
so; it is done when the symptom is observably gone on the build that carries your commit.
Project facts (how to run one test, the deploy target, how an agent reaches a signed-in
state) live in `receipts.config.json` - use them rather than inventing your own.

The honesty ladder - a gate you cannot clear never becomes a silent "fixed":
- **fixed** - reproduced and observably gone on the right build (the only success).
- **unverified-reasoned** - real root cause + a test on the path, but you could not observe
  it; route to someone who can, not "fixed".
- **speculative** - no confirmed cause; loudest flag, human sign-off on high-stakes surfaces
  (money / auth / contracts / destructive migrations).
- **reverted** - you backed the change out (e.g. wrong surface).
Carry the rung as a tag in the PR body (`unverified-reasoned: <why>`). "I could not verify
this" is a respectable, tracked outcome; a false "fixed" is not.

In-session tripwires block a `git commit` with no test run since you last edited production
source, and an edit to a test you just saw FAILING. When a block genuinely does not apply,
carry the ack IN the action, never a silent skip: `RECEIPTS_ACK='<why>'` prefixed on the
command, or `--no-verify-receipts` in the commit message; for a test that truly must change,
a `test-removal: <why>` note in the edit.

The full gates G0-G19 (reproduce first, the surface the reporter sees, the terminal action,
parallel twins, dependents, the right build, ...) and the scars behind each are in
`.receipts/gates.md`, generated next to this block by `receipts init` - read it before your
first fix here.
<!-- END receipts gates -->
